# `aitbc gpu-onchain register`

Register GPU immutable specs on the blockchain with a signing wallet.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | GPU unique identifier |
| `--miner-id` | text | — | yes | Miner/provider ID |
| `--model` | text | — | yes | GPU model (e.g., RTX 4090) |
| `--memory-gb` | integer | — | yes | GPU memory in GB |
| `--cuda-version` | text | — | no | CUDA version |
| `--region` | text | — | no | Geographic region |
| `--capabilities` | text (multiple) | — | no | GPU capabilities (can specify multiple) |
| `--price-per-hour` | decimal | — | yes | Price per hour in AIT |
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name for signing |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Wait for the transaction to be mined |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain register --gpu-id <gpu_id> --miner-id <miner_id> --model <model> --memory-gb <memory_gb> --price-per-hour <price_per_hour> --wallet <wallet>
```
